name: patternwise
description: Analyze, critique and refactor an existing codebase with design patterns and code smells: smell -> refactoring -> pattern, step by step with tests.

interface.shortDescription: Find code smells, judge design patterns, refactor safely
interface.longDescription: Use patternwise to review a codebase's design: it detects code smells, gives each existing design pattern a verdict (sound, misapplied, name only, over-engineered), suggests refactorings only where they fix a real problem, and applies them step by step with tests after you approve a plan.
